author: /root/quantitative_route
construction: Exact scalar rpow derivatives use the actual positive value and its reciprocal, both with an explicit K W^K cost.
Both signs of the real exponent are handled before composing, so reciprocal and fractional power costs use the same numerical envelope.
The existing weighted coordinate-composition theorem keeps one fixed low order and one fixed loss before the exponent, coefficients, state, envelope, actual field and point.
Zeroth order is estimated directly; positive orders use the actual outer and inner derivatives. No compact rectangle derivative choice or auxiliary localization radius appears.
limits: This is a low-level arithmetic adapter. Actual root coefficient/divisor jets and their numerical lower bounds remain genuine upstream input obligations. It does not assert a final root or primitive estimate.
